Diagnose the CI failure from the actual workflow and run receipt.

Reconstruct the checked-out commit and changed files; identify the failing
job/step, command, environment, and earliest actionable error; trace the
affected dependency; distinguish source defect, test defect, environment
failure, and infrastructure failure; preserve the objective; propose the
smallest validated correction; and rerun the narrowest relevant check. Record
the failure shape, successful recovery, and remaining uncertainty.
